hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { git pull --rebase --autostash -q >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; echo '=== Briefing (00 Home/Now.md), loaded automatically ==='; cat "00 Home/Now.md"; echo; echo "Today: $(date '+%A %Y-%m-%d %H:%M')"; f="01 Daily/$(date +%F).md"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then echo "=== Today's daily note ($f) ==="; cat "$f"; else echo 'No daily note for today yet.'; fi
